name: helix
description: Connect Codex to a scoped H E L I X instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped H E L I X tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to H E L I X through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so H E L I X Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use H E L I X only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
